claude-code.description: Claude via the local Claude Code CLI. Handoff-only read-only second opinion with no file or shell access: paste the plan, diff, or code excerpts into the task. Use for cross-model critique of risky plans or diffs alongside reviewer or oracle; not for repo exploration.

claude-code-writer.description: Claude via the local Claude Code CLI. Second implementation worker alongside worker, with Read/Write/Edit/Glob/Grep only and no shell. Give it a well-specified, bounded change with the files and expected validation named; it cannot run tests, so the parent or worker validates afterward. Keep one writer per cwd/worktree; use a separate worktree when it runs in parallel with worker.
